assessment: Osteoporosis most often treated by reducing bone resorption as there are limited choices of medication that are anabolic for bone. Previous studies have suggested that the Notch signaling pathway could be targeted to enhance osteogenesis. The authors have intriguingly generated a soluble bone targeted fusion protein comprised of a modified version of the extra-cellular domain of the Delta-like 4 Notch ligand and poly-aspartate peptide motif with binding affinity for hydroxyapatite in the bone matrix. This approach has high potential as a future therapeutic for osteoporosis.
